remarks: Set along a tree-lined street with views of the surrounding hills and beautiful neighboring estates, 5295 College View Avenue presents an exceptional opportunity to reimagine a character-filled home in Eagle Rock. Offered as-is, this three-bedroom, two-bath fixer invites a thoughtful renovation that honors its architectural roots while creating a fresh vision for modern living. Original plans and construction specifications reflect an emphasis on craftsmanship, with details such as oak flooring, custom woodwork, and a brick fireplace, an inspiring reference for its next chapter. The existing layout includes separate living and family rooms, a dining area, and a dedicated laundry room. Front
